how.title: How to play
how.mastermind: Crack the hidden colour code in the tries you get. A filled dot means the right colour in the right place, a ring means the right colour in the wrong place. Colours can repeat. A hint shows one peg of the code.
how.higher-lower: The first term shows about how often it is searched on Google each month. Is the second term searched more or less? Counts are rough estimates. A streak of 6 solves the day; one wrong guess ends it.
how.math-24: Tap a card, an operation, then a second card to merge them into one. Make exactly 24 from all four. Fractions are allowed, and some days need them. A hint shows the next step.
how.sliding-3x3: Put the tiles in order, 1 upwards with the gap last. Tap a tile next to the gap, or swipe it towards the gap; a whole row or column moves together. A hint points at the next tile.
how.memory-match: Flip two cards at a time. Matching cards stay up. Find all the pairs in as few flips as you can. A hint shows one pair for a moment and marks it.
how.wordle: Find the five-letter word in six tries. Green: right letter, right place. Yellow: in the word, wrong place. Grey: not in the word.
how.quordle: Four Wordles at once, one set of guesses, nine tries. Each key shows four colours, one per board. A solved board stops.
how.anagram: Unscramble three words of six, seven and eight letters, one after another. Tap letters to place them, tap a placed letter to take it back. Six mistakes in total end the game; a hint locks one correct letter.
how.hangman: Guess the word one letter at a time. Six wrong letters and the drawing is complete. A hint reveals a letter without costing a life.
how.word-ladder: Change one letter at a time to get from the start word to the target. Tap a letter, pick its replacement; every step must be a real word. Any route counts, par is the shortest one.
how.connections: Find four groups of four words that share something. Pick four tiles and submit. Beware of words that fit two groups. Four mistakes end the game.
how.spelling-bee: Make words of four or more letters that use the centre letter. Four letters score 1 point, longer words one per letter, a pangram (all seven letters) +7.
how.sudoku-mini: Fill the 6x6 grid so every row, column and 2x3 box holds 1 to 6 once. A wrong digit is a mistake: three mistakes end the game. Notes do not count.
how.sudoku: Fill the grid so every row, column and 3x3 box holds 1 to 9 once. A wrong digit is a mistake: three mistakes end the game. Notes do not count.
how.minesweeper: A number counts the mines around it. Every board is fair: an opening is already clear and you can always work out the next move, no guessing. Tap to dig, long-press (or right-click) to flag, tap a number with all its flags to open the rest around it. Hint shows a safe cell or a mine.
how.nonogram: Numbers give the runs of filled cells in each line. Drag across cells to fill a line, use Mark to cross out cells that must stay empty.
how.takuzu: Tap a cell to cycle empty, 0, 1. No three equal in a row, as many 0s as 1s in every row and column, and no two identical rows or columns.
how.lights-out: Pressing a light flips it and its four neighbours. Switch them all off in as few moves as you can.
how.bridges: Join the islands with straight bridges. An island's number is how many bridges it has, at most two between a pair, none crossing, and all islands end up connected. Tap two islands in line, or drag between them.
how.queens: Place one queen in every row, column and colour region. No two queens may touch, not even diagonally. Tap once for an X mark, twice for a queen. A hint places a correct queen.
how.word-search: Drag from the first to the last letter of a hidden word. Words run right, down and, on harder levels, diagonally or backwards. A found word stays highlighted. A hint outlines the first letter of a word. On a keyboard, arrows move the cursor and Space or Enter starts and ends a selection.
how.country-wordle: Guess the country in 6 tries (8 on easy). Each tile compares your guess with the answer: distance and direction, region, shared border, population, area and coast. Green is a match, yellow is close.
how.flaggle: The flag starts as a blur and gets sharper with every wrong guess. Guess the country in 6 tries; a hint sharpens the flag by a full step.
how.capital-quiz: Name the capital of each of 6 countries. Beware of the big cities that are not the capital. A hint removes two wrong options.
how.outline-guess: Five rounds. Facts about a country appear one at a time and the fewer you use, the more points you earn: 6 for one fact, down to 1 for all six, 0 if you are wrong. Reach 15 points.
how.shape-guess: Name the country from its outline in 6 guesses. Each guess shows the distance, direction and continent to the answer. A hint reveals the continent, then the first letter.
how.quiz-knowledge: Eight questions on everything from culture to tech: three easy (1 point), three medium (2), two hard (3). Reach 60% of the points to solve it. A hint removes two wrong answers.
how.quiz-science: Eight science questions: three easy (1 point), three medium (2), two hard (3). Reach 60% of the points to solve it. A hint removes two wrong answers.
how.quiz-history: Eight history questions: three easy (1 point), three medium (2), two hard (3). Reach 60% of the points to solve it. A hint removes two wrong answers.
how.quiz-travel: Eight travel and geography questions: three easy (1 point), three medium (2), two hard (3). Reach 60% of the points to solve it. A hint removes two wrong answers.
how.crossword-mini: Fill the 5x5 grid from the clues. Tap a square to select it, tap again to switch between across and down. A word is judged as soon as it is full: a right word locks, a wrong one is cleared again. Hints cost coins and lock a letter.
how.crossword: Fill the 7x7 grid from the clues. Tap a square to select it, tap again to switch between across and down. A word is judged as soon as it is full: a right word locks, a wrong one is cleared again. Easy has more blocks and shorter words, hard has long ones. Hints cost coins and lock a letter.
how.word-trail: Trace words on the letter tiles: drag across neighbouring tiles (diagonals count, no tile twice in a word), or tap them one by one and press Enter. A word that is an answer of the crossword fills in. Tiles can be reused for other words. A hint places one word and shows its path.
